info.title: Corpus Ranker API
info.description: REST binding of the SPEC A3 operations (TECH-STACK §1). operationId is the SPEC A3 operation name; the MCP adapter maps tools 1:1 onto these. Domain objects are the versioned SPEC A2 JSON Schemas under schemas/v1/. Every write carries the acting agent identity; per-agent, per-operation scopes are enforced by the service.

post.summary: Capture raw material as an Original (dedup by content hash). Never scores or classifies inline.

200.description: Identical bytes already captured; the existing Original is returned.

post.summary: Propose a Classification for an Item (or the Item resting on an Original).

value.rationale: Abstract centres on agent memory and context windows.

post.summary: Commit a pending Classification; may set Item canonical fields and create a reversible same_as merge.
Record a Score event under a cited Policy version.

409.description: The cited policy version is not the current citable version.

post.summary: Retract a Score event; it stays in history and dependent views are marked stale.
Compute a new Ranked View under a Policy version.
Ordered top-N entries, small enough to hand a model as pre-digested context.

entries.title: Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
entries.summary: Proposes a hierarchical memory for agent context.

get.summary: Every contributing Score event for an Item under a Policy, plus retraction/supersession state.

post.summary: Re-score or re-derive composites under a new Policy version without touching old Score events; produces new views and a diff.
Vector + filter retrieval over Items. Unscored items are included and marked; retrieval is not ranking.

item.title: Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
item.summary: Proposes a hierarchical memory for agent context.

post.summary: Mark an Item superseded; edges are written and dependent views go stale.

200.description: Superseded Item, written edges and stale views.

item.title: Context Management for Long-Horizon Agents
item.summary: Proposes a hierarchical memory for agent context.

post.summary: Produce the full portable bundle (SPEC A5).

403.description: The acting agent lacks the scope for this operation.

409.description: Conflicts with the object's current state.

canonical_fields.description: Canonical fields to set on the Item.

same_as_item_id.description: Record a reversible same_as merge with this Item.

mode.description: rescore: new Score events under to_version; recompose: re-derive composites from existing scores.

scored.description: False for items with no live Score event; retrieval is not ranking.

type.description: Shared supersession vocabulary (SPEC §4); Ranker semantics: views go stale, re-derive offline.

corpus_id.description: Omit or null to export all corpora.
